name: Rajma Masala with Basmati Rice

components.name: Rajma Masala

ingredients.name: Canned red kidney beans, drained and rinsed weight

steps: Drain the canned cooked kidney beans; this is a pre-cooked input. If using dry kidney beans, thoroughly boil until safe; do not put undercooked dried kidney beans into the sauce.
Saute onion with oil until light golden; add ginger, garlic and ground spices briefly.
Add tomatoes and cook until they have broken down and the oil begins to separate.
Stir in drained beans and water; simmer covered 15-20 minutes, crushing some beans to thicken gravy.
Pack rajma and rice separately. Reheat rajma thoroughly and loosen with a measured splash of water if needed.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Cook rinsed basmati rice in measured water and rest covered.
